lede: UCLA carries the stronger underlying team rating — +9.1 against +8.9, a 0.2-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Oregon -7.4 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Oregon winning 69% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is run offense, where UCLA leads Oregon by 103 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
